fichas.title: Water Plants for a Natural Swimming Pool
fichas.summary: Planting guidance for natural swimming pools, organized by shallow-water, water-lily, bog, and wet zones. Ecological natural swimming pools require a self-cleaning zone of water plants occupying about one-third of the total area. The page includes plant lists with botanical names, flowering months, and flower colours, plus a planting-depth diagram and oxygenation-plant list.
